subject: Post-discovery: stakeholder lattice and security-scope kickoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cindy Park <cindy@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: Post-discovery: stakeholder lattice and security-scope kickoff

Cindy — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get the security intake moving: 

- Key outcomes from call:
  • Use case confirmed: restricted customer support summaries (PII redaction required).
  • Expected QPS during pilot: ~75 requests/minute with 512-token average.
  • Success criteria: <200ms p50, deterministic data residency in us-east-1, SOC2 evidence.

- Immediate asks (can you confirm?):
  1) Economic buyer: who signs the PO? (you mentioned Asha — can you share best contact email)
  2) Procurement contact and any standard vendor terms or template they require (procure@?).
  3) Systems in scope for ingestion: which internal apps will send data to Redwood (S3 buckets, internal APIs, agent endpoints)?
  4) Timeline for the vendor questionnaire — you can upload to the Google doc linked below or attach the PDF.

- Proposed next steps from our side:
  • We’ll schedule a 30–45m security kickoff next week to walk the questionnaire and draft the systems boundary.
  • Ben will run a light triage on the questionnaire and surface any must-have controls.
  • Marissa will own procurement coordination and produce a minimal procurement checklist for your team.

Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcdExampleQuestionnaire
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/vb-2027-0491

Attachments referenced: vendor questionnaire placeholder, SOC2 summary (we'll attach Redwood's high-level SOC2 evidence summary).

Thanks — let me know if anything above is off. If you can confirm the economic buyer and procurement email, we’ll lock the kickoff slot.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri@yredwood.example

From: Cindy Park <cindy@vaultbank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Varma <asha.varma@vaultbank.com>, procure@vaultbank.com
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: stakeholder lattice and security-scope kickoff

Hi Priyom — great to connect yesterday. Quick answers below and attached the questionnaire you referenced.

1) Economic buyer: Asha Varma (VP, Platform) — she manages vendor spend above $50k. I’ve CC'd her here.
2) Procurement: procure@vaultbank.com is the mailbox; primary procurement lead is Jason Lee (they may route legal to our GC).
3) Systems in scope: initial pilot will ingest support transcripts from our internal Kustomer instance (SaaS) and a dedicated S3 bucket (s3://vaultbank-pilot-support). No direct DB access.
4) Questionnaire: attached as "VaultBank-Vendor-Questionnaire.pdf" — the procurement team prefers a PDF back-and-forth.

Other asks: can you provide a short SOC2 summary and a simple network boundary diagram showing where Redwood sits relative to our agents? That will speed internal review.

Attachment: VaultBank-Vendor-Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

Thanks,
Cindy Park
Head of Platform Integrations
VaultBank Inc.
cindy@vaultbank.com

Looping in Karthik as well for technical boundary notes. Plan:

- Ben: I’ll do initial questionnaire triage. Deliverable: a callout doc with must-have items and clear asks for VaultBank (24–48h).

Proposed kickoff: Wed 16 Jun 2027, 11:00–11:45 PT. If that works for VaultBank we can send a calendar invite.

- 10m intros & goals
- 20m questionnaire walkthrough (VaultBank Qs)
- 10m systems boundary review (Ben/Karthik)
- 5m next steps / procurement timeline (Marissa)
